## The History Is Already Written by the Time the Patient Walks In.

A staff member schedules an interview in minutes. The patient gets a link, verifies with a one-time code, and answers a guided medical history at their own pace, either typing or talking to a virtual doctor on a call. Nobody transcribes anything.

Every completed session becomes a structured report routed to one named provider, who reviews it, adds notes, and marks it reviewed. Solo practitioners and multi-provider organizations run the same workflow. What changes is who can see what.
